title: One file, one video
summary: How a single plan file becomes a narrated, animated YouTube video and a Short.

scenes.narration: This whole video started as one small text file.
From that one file, the engine makes two videos: a wide one and a Short.
It records the voice, animates every scene and writes the upload checklist.
You don't open an editor. You write scenes, then run one command.

props.verdict: Write the plan. Run the render.

scenes.narration: Keep every scene to one sentence, so the pictures change often.

props.label: Tip
props.title: One sentence per scene
props.text: Short scenes keep the picture moving and the timing exact.

scenes.narration: Now make your own. Copy this plan, change the words and render it.
